description: How one landing page changed over time: its dated captures, newest first, each with a screenshot and the offers read from it. Use it for 'what did they change on this page' and to see when an offer appeared or deepened. The window depends on the plan. Fields the user's Replo plan doesn't include come back null and are named in that item's `locked` list (`estimates` = sales, visits and traffic); `lockedCount` is how many more results a higher plan shows. Say the data is on a higher plan; never estimate it yourself. Returns data only: nothing is shown to the user yet. Once you know the answer, call sightglass_show once with this call's resultId to show it as cards; the show call does not search again.

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects: where the charge or the asset lands. Its workspace's plan applies.

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Sets which workspace's plan applies; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_get_site_page_versions
title: Get landing page history
